review.scope: Complete 23 November 2026 Formula 1 and MotoGP update, including the newly completed weekends, current standings, future sessions, photos, archive and model output.
review.visual_review: Spoiler-safe initial desktop/mobile views, full newest classifications, current standings and both 320 px tables were readable without clipping or horizontal page overflow.
review.reproducibility: A second 200,000-trial run per championship reproduced every title result, eligibility result, invariant and backtest exactly; only the calculation timestamp and elapsed seconds differed.
review.photos: Both new 960 × 640 local images decoded in Chromium. Individual Commons creator and licence pages were checked; visible credits, exact licence/version links, modification disclosures, dimensions and hashes are recorded.
limitations: No physical screen-reader audit; keyboard operation, focus visibility, hidden/inert behaviour and accessibility-tree exclusion were tested in Chromium.
The empirical model has limited historical validation and no completed-championship calibration; its saved five-race rolling diagnostics are not proof of predictive calibration.
This run did not freshly re-audit every older result, archived claim or historical steward decision unrelated to the new weekends.
